papers.why_it_matters: Two things. (1) An independent group ran a Bayesian-block, time-resolved Band analysis of THIS burst, and their published-but-online-only figure set + machine-readable table contain the per-bin alpha, beta, Ep, norm. That is a real external validation set for our Steps 5 and 6 - the same role Li & Zhang 2021 played for bn081224887. (2) The REJECTION itself is a datum: the burst passed the time-integrated and peak-flux hardness cuts but FAILED the '>= 80% of T70 bins' test, so more than ~20% of its bright-phase bins have alpha <= -0.45 or beta outside (-3.3,-1.7). Our archival block track (alpha = +0.06, -0.37, -0.29, -0.37, -0.74) reproduces exactly that pattern: hard early, dropping below -0.45 by the last block.
papers.internal_inconsistency_T5: The abstract states the low-energy cut as 'alpha > -0.5'; SS2 uses -0.5 for the time-integrated spectrum and -0.45 for the peak spectrum; SS2.1 then describes 'A relatively hard low-energy index (alpha > -0.45)' as the criterion generally. Recorded, NOT resolved - it matters for reproducing their 41-burst list.
